findings.evidence: Swift onOpenURL stores a new request UUID; updateUIViewController deduplicates that UUID and forwards to the receiving window session. Session caches one controller. openURL reads EDIT_IN_PLACE on a worker and delivers on main. No explicit UIWindow or extra Compose controller is created by openURL itself.

EditorDocuments.openCopy invokes IMPORT_COPY; UIDocumentPicker asCopy=true is presented above the existing host controller. Its selection uses the same read pipeline. IMPORT_COPY writes Caches/LogisimExports; neither route changes renderer settings or clears graphic caches.

Product generated plist supports multiple scenes; WindowGroup/SceneStorage allocates per-window document sessions. UIKit control also supports multiple scenes and handles connection URL contexts plus openURLContexts. Configured support establishes neither current scene/window counts nor which route the OS selected in the failed run.

Control a8e32bc2 uses UIKit labels and stack views without Compose/Skiko, creates a UIWindow for each connected UIWindowScene, and performs scoped/coordinated read/hash in its callback. Its test uses one public System Open and checks exact 1391-byte hash in an active key scene. It does not exercise the product parser/workspace/Compose frontend.

Product configure block sets only OnFocusBehavior.DoNothing. Local Beta KLIB IR initializes opaque, parallelRendering and enforceStrictPlistSanityCheck to true. Opaque/parallelRendering are public experimental options, not a documented backend switch in this configuration.

Local Skiko iOS0.156.1 KLIB IR returns GraphicsApi.METAL from SkiaLayer.renderApi; its setter throws UnsupportedOperationException. Presence of SOFTWARE enum values alone does not establish a supported iOS software fallback.

limits: No runtime census performed; no current window/scene/texture counts inferred.
Local dependency KLIB IR is identified by path/hash and product-declared version; this report is not a disassembly proving the active renderer class in the failing process.
Producer artifact manifest identities were read; full bundle tree was not independently recomputed here.
UIKit AD28 PASS timing/events and FilesImportCopy PASS belong to the separate census receipts. This source audit does not re-run or independently re-qualify them.
Cold System Open may entail new scene/controller/render initialization; FilesImportCopy presupposes a mounted host. This is a source-path distinction, not a causal attribution of the abort.
